たかくて.en: and; even if it is expensive

bloques.titulo: In the case of «though / even if», it is stated that the condition does not prevent the result.
texto: For verbs it uses the form of the same; with adjectives and names it changes the corresponding form. It contrasts with the United States, which does not express a concession on its own.
(Even if it rains, I will go for a walk.)

frases.ja: たかくて も、この くつ を かいます。
frases.es: Aunque sea caro, compraré estos zapatos.
frases.en: Even if it's expensive, I'll buy these shoes.
